tests_written.rationale: Tests lock the reference graph, role routing, old-Agent mapping, and absence of packaged agent projections.

tests_passed.rationale: The focused Skill and role contract suite exited zero and is repeated by the release gate.

persistence_real.rationale: This task moves reusable reasoning methods and introduces no storage path.

feature_flags_audit.rationale: Routing is installed metadata and caller structure, not a runtime feature flag.

vertical_slice.rationale: Adapter tests install the portable Skill assets into every host surface and inspect the result.

spec_trace.rationale: The architecture maps every retired custom-agent method to its current Skill-owned home.

limitations: Host-native custom-agent UIs are intentionally not emulated across all five CLIs.
